jobs.description:
For our client located in DIKSMUIDE, we are looking for a CNC SETTER.

Our client is a technical and innovative company active in the manufacturing industry. They offer a family-oriented working environment and are committed to investing in both technology and their employees.

As a CNC SETTER in the DIKSMUIDE region, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

  • Setting up and programming CNC machines (mainly 3-axis lathes);
  • Producing unique pieces based on technical drawings (limited series production);
  • Setting up and programming CNC machines;
  • Reading and interpreting technical drawings prepared by the engineering department;
  • Measuring finished parts and comparing them with the technical drawings;
  • Checking the quality of the manufactured parts;
  • Working mainly with 3-axis lathes.

As a CNC SETTER in the DIKSMUIDE region, you can identify yourself with the following:

  • You have experience setting up CNC-controlled machines;
  • You have a good understanding of reading technical drawings, machining techniques, measurement techniques, and determining tolerances;
  • You can operate an overhead crane or are willing to learn this internally;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

For our client located in DIKSMUIDE, we are looking for a MECHANICAL ASSEMBLER FIELD.

Our client is a well-known company active in water pumps and water treatment. They are a close-knit team where employees are always the number one priority.

As a MECHANICAL ASSEMBLER FIELD in the DIKSMUIDE region, you will perform the following tasks:

  • Installing and assembling screw pumps, water treatment installations, bridges, and other structures on-site;
  • Ensuring the commissioning of these installations or carrying out maintenance work;
  • Performing necessary repairs and renovation works when required;
  • Working mainly in Belgium, with occasional assignments in the Netherlands, France, and Germany;
  • Staying overnight in hotels when required;
  • Working with various welding machines and, when necessary, operating equipment such as overhead cranes and aerial work platforms.
As a MECHANICAL ASSEMBLER FIELD in the DIKSMUIDE region, you can identify yourself with the following:

  • You have a technically oriented diploma with knowledge of welding techniques;
  • You are willing to occasionally stay overnight in a hotel, as the projects are carried out on different locations;
  • You are not afraid of outdoor work and large constructions;
  • You have a good understanding of reading technical drawings and using various assembly techniques and equipment;
  • You are able to work independently and take initiative;
  • You have a driving licence B;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

For our client in the ICHTEGEM region, we are looking for a CE TIPPER TRUCK DRIVER.

Our client is a family-owned company specialized in bulk transport, concrete transport, tipper truck transport and traction transport.

As a CE TIPPER TRUCK DRIVER in ICHTEGEM, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

  • Delivering soil and waste materials from earthworks using a tipper truck;
  • Transporting and delivering materials in accordance with safety regulations and applicable instructions;
  • Cleaning the truck;
  • Communicating with customers in a friendly and professional manner;
  • Unloading the truck at construction sites and driving back to reload.
As a CE DRIVER in NIEUWPOORT, you can identify with the following:

  • Experience as a CE DRIVER;
  • You are in possession of a CE driving licence, a valid Code 95 and a driver card;
  • You speak Dutch OR English OR French.

Are you an experienced asphalt worker who enjoys rolling up your sleeves?

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced asphalt worker to join our asphalt crew.

What does your job involve?

  • You assist the asphalt crew with the preparation, laying and finishing of hot-mix asphalt;
  • You help ensure the correct distribution and finishing of the asphalt;
  • You are responsible for touching up and finishing asphalt around joints and connections;
  • You help create a smooth and high-quality road surface;
  • You work closely with machine operators, roller operators, drivers and other colleagues on site;
  • You work with modern machinery, techniques and tools;
  • You depart daily from Oostende.
What do we expect from you?

  • You have experience in asphalt works, preferably as an asphalt worker;
  • You have knowledge of the different steps involved in laying and finishing hot-mix asphalt;
  • You are physically fit and enjoy active, hands-on work;
  • You are flexible and have no problem working in different weather conditions;
  • You speak fluent Dutch or English;
  • You are able to get to our depot in Oostende independently every day.

Are you an experienced roller operator with a passion for asphalt works?

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced roller operator for our asphalt works.

What does your job involve?

  • You independently operate the road roller during asphalt works.
  • You ensure the correct and even compaction of the asphalt according to the required quality standards.
  • You take into account the temperature and composition of the asphalt and adapt your working method accordingly.
  • You work closely with machine operators, drivers and other colleagues in the asphalt crew.
  • You help monitor the quality of the road surface and ensure that the works are carried out accurately.
  • You work with modern machines, techniques and tools.
  • You carry out daily checks and help ensure the proper maintenance of the machine.
  • You depart daily from the depot in Oostende.
What do we expect from you?

  • You have experience as a road roller operator, preferably in asphalt or road construction.
  • You have a good understanding of asphalt compaction and understand the importance of using the correct rolling technique.
  • You have good technical insight and can work confidently with modern machinery.
  • You are flexible and have no problem working in different weather conditions.
  • You speak fluent Dutch or English.
  • You are able to get to our depot in Oostende independently every day.

For the strengthening of our team, we are looking for a truck driver with a Category C driving licence to operate our emulsion truck.

You will depart from our depot in Oostende and drive to various construction sites throughout West Flanders. In addition to the transport, you will also be responsible for the correct application and processing of the emulsion on site, meaning you will be active both behind the wheel and on the construction site.

Your responsibilities:

  • You transport emulsion from our depot in Oostende to various construction sites throughout West Flanders;
  • You are responsible for the correct and safe loading and unloading of emulsion;
  • You operate the emulsion truck's equipment and ensure the correct application of the emulsion;
  • You work both with machinery and manually during the processing of emulsion on site.



What do we expect from you?

  • You have a valid Category C driving licence.
  • Code 95 is NOT required.
  • You have good technical insight and are willing to learn how the emulsion truck operates and how emulsion is processed on site.
  • You speak and understand sufficient Dutch or English to communicate safely and smoothly with your colleagues.

Would you like to help build high-quality roads throughout West Flanders? Then we would love to hear from you!

For our client in the Veurne area, we are looking for a DIAGNOSTIC TECHNICIAN.

Our client is a well-known garage in Veurne with a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere. They are looking for a new colleague to join their team.

They are a well-established garage with a modern, clean and fully equipped workshop.

As a DIAGNOSTIC TECHNICIAN in the Veurne area, your responsibilities will include:

  • Working independently on cars and vans;
  • Carrying out technical and electrical maintenance on passenger cars and vans;
  • Performing diagnostics on vehicles;
  • Dismantling and repairing engines;
  • Replacing timing belts.
As a DIAGNOSTIC TECHNICIAN in the Veurne area, you meet the following requirements:

  • You have experience as a vehicle mechanic, preferably with experience as a diagnostic technician;
  • You are in possession of a valid category B driving licence;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

Are you an independent electrician who enjoys working on technical projects and is not afraid of a new challenge?

Would you like to work on ships and join a working environment where you are given a lot of responsibility and freedom?

For a growing company specialized in ship repair and technical maintenance, we are looking for a SHIP ELECTRICIAN.

As a SHIP ELECTRICIAN, your responsibilities will include:

  • Carrying out electrical maintenance and repair work on ships;
  • Working on different ships, both at the workshop in Ostend and on-site throughout West Flanders;
  • Starting on site and working independently on the planned tasks;
  • Performing electrical tests and inspections;
  • Disconnecting electrical components and wiring from engines;
  • Troubleshooting electrical faults and finding suitable solutions;
  • Carrying out electrical interventions and repairs;
  • Actively thinking along with technical challenges and independently looking for solutions.
As a SHIP ELECTRICIAN in OSTEND, you recognize yourself in the following:

  • You have a technical education or background, preferably in industrial electricity;
  • You speak Dutch OR English;
  • You have a driving licence B;
  • You preferably have experience in an industrial environment;
  • Experience in the maritime sector is a plus, but not an absolute requirement;
  • You are able to work independently and do not need constant supervision;
  • You are a real problem-solver who takes initiative and looks for solutions yourself;
  • You are not afraid to take responsibility.

Are you an independent mechanic who enjoys working on technical projects and is not afraid of a new challenge?

Would you like to work on ships and join an environment where you are given a lot of responsibility and freedom?

For a growing company specialised in ship repair and technical maintenance, we are looking for a MARINE MECHANIC.

As a SHIP MECHANIC, your responsibilities will include:

  • Performing mechanical maintenance and repairs on ships;
  • Working on different vessels, both at the workshop in Ostend and on-site throughout West Flanders;
  • Starting on-site and working independently on the scheduled tasks;
  • Being responsible for the maintenance, dismantling and assembly of mechanical components;
  • Working on engines, drive systems, pumps and other mechanical installations;
  • Detecting mechanical faults and defects and providing suitable solutions;
  • Carrying out mechanical interventions and repairs;
  • Checking and testing installations after completing the work;
  • Actively thinking along with technical issues and independently looking for solutions.
As a MARINE MECHANIC in OSTEND, you recognise yourself in the following:

  • You have a technical education or background, preferably in industrial mechanics;
  • You speak Dutch OR English;
  • You have a valid driving licence B;
  • Previous experience in an industrial environment is preferred;
  • Experience in the maritime sector is a plus, but not an absolute requirement;
  • You can work independently and do not need constant supervision;
  • You are proactive and resourceful and know how to find solutions yourself;
  • You are willing to take responsibility.

For our client, we are looking for a PLASTERER.

As an all-round plasterer, you will be responsible for various plastering and finishing works. You will work on both interior and exterior projects and ensure a neat and high-quality finish every time.

Your responsibilities as a PLASTERER:

  • Carrying out plastering works;
  • Preparing surfaces;
  • Applying and finishing interior and exterior plaster;
  • Repairing and touching up existing plasterwork;
  • Finishing corners, edges and connections;
  • Working with spray cork;
  • Working with different materials and techniques;
  • Ensuring a neat and high-quality finish;
  • Working on different construction sites and projects.
This is you as a PLASTERER:

  • You have experience as a plasterer or renovation worker;
  • You can work independently, but also work well as part of a team;
  • You have an eye for detail and deliver a neat finish;
  • You are physically fit;
  • You speak Dutch or fluent Englisch;
  • You have a valid category B driving licence.

As an ELECTROMECHANIC – DAY SHIFT in WEST FLANDERS, you will work closely with our clients to ensure the optimal performance and efficiency of their machinery and contribute to their operational success.

Your responsibilities as an ELECTROMECHANIC in WEST FLANDERS:

  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical and electrical faults, including under time pressure;
  • Carry out preventive maintenance according to the maintenance schedule;
  • Actively contribute ideas for improvements related to machinery, safety, quality and efficiency;
  • Participate in optimization and continuous improvement projects;
  • Contribute to a smooth and efficient production environment;
  • Work in a refrigerated production environment (4–6°C) that is cleaned industrially on a daily basis. Safety, cleanliness and quality are key priorities.
AS AN ELECTROMECHANIC IN WEST FLANDERS, YOU RECOGNIZE YOURSELF IN THE FOLLOWING:
  • You have a degree in electromechanics or relevant experience as a maintenance or breakdown technician, with a strong focus on electrical systems;
  • You have an analytical mindset and can quickly identify and resolve technical faults efficiently;
  • You can work independently and take responsibility in a mature and professional manner;
  • You have a good command of Dutch or English;
  • You are motivated to grow and develop within a company that is continuously expanding.

Apply now for this vacancy or send your CV to westkust@absolutejobs.be.

For our client located in BRUGES, we are looking for a ROOFER.

Do you enjoy working at heights and do you have experience as a roofer, mainly working on pitched roofs? Then we are looking for you!

As a ROOFER in the Bruges region, your day will look like this:

  • Mainly covering pitched roofs, but occasionally also flat roofs;
  • Renovating existing roofs (no new-build projects);
  • Installing roofing materials;
  • Assessing the structural characteristics of existing roofs;
  • Installing and sealing carpentry elements in the roof;
  • Bonding and installing EPDM.
As a ROOFER in BRUGES, you have the following qualities:

  • You have solid work experience as a roofer, with experience working on pitched roofs;
  • You have a category B driving licence;
  • The starting location is Bruges, Blauwe-Toren area;
  • You speak Dutch or English;
  • You are not afraid of heights.

For our client, a well-known company in the VEURNE region, we are looking for a RENOVATION WORKER.

Do you enjoy variety in your job and do you like renovation work? Then you are the person we are looking for!

As a RENOVATION WORKER in the VEURNE region, your day will look like this:

  • Together with your colleagues, you will carry out demolition and repair work as part of renovation projects;
  • Carrying out general renovation works on houses and buildings;
  • Demolition works and preparing the construction site;
  • Bricklaying, plastering and small concrete works;
  • Installing and repairing floors and walls;
  • Installing insulation and drywall/plasterboard;
  • Ensuring that the entire renovation project is completed to a high standard;
  • Ensuring that structural works and stability requirements are properly taken into account.
As a RENOVATION WORKER in VEURNE, you have the following qualities:

  • You have solid work experience as a renovation worker and are fully familiar with flooring, carpentry, bricklaying, etc.;
  • You have a category B driving licence;
  • The starting location is Bruges (Blauwe-Toren), at the company’s warehouse;
  • You speak Dutch or English;
  • You are not afraid of heights.

For our client, a well-known company in the BRUGES region, we are looking for a RENOVATION WORKER.

Do you enjoy variety in your job and do you like renovation work? Then you are the person we are looking for!

As a RENOVATION WORKER in the BRUGES region, your day will look like this:

  • Together with your colleagues, you will carry out demolition and repair work as part of renovation projects;
  • Carrying out general renovation works on houses and buildings;
  • Demolition works and preparing the construction site;
  • Bricklaying, plastering and small concrete works;
  • Installing and repairing floors and walls;
  • Installing insulation and drywall/plasterboard;
  • Ensuring that the entire renovation project is completed to a high standard;
  • Ensuring that structural works and stability requirements are properly taken into account.
As a RENOVATION WORKER in BRUGES, you have the following qualities:

  • You have solid work experience as a renovation worker and are fully familiar with flooring, carpentry, bricklaying, etc.;
  • You have a category B driving licence;
  • The starting location is Bruges (Blauwe-Toren), at the company’s warehouse;
  • You speak Dutch or English;
  • You are not afraid of heights.

What will you do?

What does your day look like as a truck driver with a Moffett?

  • You start early in the morning (between 5 AM and 6 AM) from our base in Deinze. Loading is not necessary – your truck is already prepared the night before. You follow a fixed route for a regular customer. On average, you make 4 to 6 deliveries per day across the Benelux.
  • You are responsible for unloading the goods yourself using the Moffett forklift attached to your truck. Our dispatch team is always ready to support you in case of questions, delays, or unexpected situations.
  • Finished with your deliveries? Then you drive back to Deinze – job done!

Interested?
Send your CV to Eeklo@absolutejobs.be

What do we expect from you?

  • You're not afraid to roll up your sleeves and get things done
  • Physical work is part of the job for you – not an obstacle
  • You have your own transportation, as the truck stays on our premises
  • You can communicate fluently in Dutch, French, or English
  • You're a team player who’s ready to help out where needed
  • You keep your truck and trailer clean and tidy
  • You maintain clear communication with dispatch and other departments

Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for logistics employees for Bleckmann Ghent. You will be working in the morning shift (05u48 - 13u48).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year (such as Black Friday in November), you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Are you interested in this opportunity? Be sure to read this vacancy!

Tasks: 

• Preparing incoming orders

• You prepare the orders in order of arrival using a scanning system

• You prepare the correct documents when packing orders

We organize bus transport from Ghent to ensure easy access to Bleckmann:  

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Sint-Pieters

• Departure at 5u10

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for logistics employees for the Bleckmann warehouses in Rieme and Desteldonk (near Ghent). You will be working in the morning shift (05u48 - 13u48) or late shift (14u00 - 22u00).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year (such as Black Friday in November), you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Are you interested in this opportunity? Be sure to read this vacancy!

Tasks: 

• Preparing incoming orders

• You prepare the orders in order of arrival using a scanning system

• You prepare the correct documents when packing orders

We organize bus transport from Ghent to ensure easy access to Bleckmann:  

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Sint-Pieters for the Rieme warehouse

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Dampoort for the Desteldonk warehouse

• Departure at 5u10 or 13u10

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

For our client, a family-run and growing company based in IZEGEM, we are looking for a production worker to strengthen the team. Do you enjoy working with fresh products, are you precise, and not afraid to work in a cooled environment? Then keep reading!
 

Your responsibilities:
 

 
• Cleaning, cutting, and packaging fruits and vegetables
 
• Working according to hygiene and quality standards
 
• Contributing to a smooth production flow
 
• You’ll work in a cooled environment of around 7°C, with appropriate clothing provided 
 

Working hours (full-time):
 

 
• Monday: off
 
• Tuesday to Friday: 7:00 AM – 1:00 PM and 1:30 PM – 4:00 PM
 
• Saturday: 6:00 AM – 12:25 PM 

 
• You speak Dutch or English
 
• You work accurately and hygienically
 
• Previous experience in the food industry is a plus, but not required
 
• You are physically fit and motivated

Do you have kitchen experience and enjoy working with fresh products? Are you hands-on, reliable, and looking for a stable job with opportunities to grow? Then we would love to meet you!
 

Your responsibilities
 

As a Production Kitchen Worker, you will be part of a motivated team responsible for preparing and processing fresh vegetables on a daily basis.
 

Your tasks include:
 

 
• Cleaning and washing vegetables.
 
• Cutting and preparing vegetables both manually and with machines.
 
• Operating vegetable cutting equipment safely and efficiently.
 
• Maintaining a clean and hygienic work environment.
 
• Following quality and food safety standards. 

 
• Previous experience in a professional kitchen is required.
 
• You are comfortable with physical work and enjoy staying active.
 
• You work accurately and pay attention to hygiene.
 
• You are available to work on Mondays and Saturdays.
 
• You can start work between 6:00 AM and 7:00 AM.
 
• You speak English or Dutch.
 
• Experience working in Belgium is not required.

You will be responsible for:
 

 
• Moving and dragging foam blocks
 
• Manually feeding the machine
 
• Picking up foam scraps from the floor
 
• Keeping the workplace clean and organized
 
• Working together with your colleague to ensure a smooth production process 

 
• You speak Dutch or English.
 
• You are physically strong and enjoy active work.
 
• You can perform repetitive tasks accurately.
 
• You enjoy working together with a colleague.
 
• Experience is not required; motivation is more important.
 
• You can work in a day shift, and when production volumes increase, you are willing to work in a 2-shift system.
